--SET SCHEMA "SBO_JBP_PROD";
SET SCHEMA "JB_PRUEBA_03MAR26";

SELECT * FROM JB_CACHE_DOCS_VET_TO_SYNC;

update JB_CACHE_DOCS_VET_TO_SYNC set PROCESANDO=0 


CREATE COLUMN TABLE "JB_CACHE_DOCS_VET_TO_SYNC" (
	"ID" INTEGER CS_INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
	"TIPO_DOC" VARCHAR(200),
	"FECHA_SINCRONIZACION" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	"VENDEDOR" VARCHAR(200),
	"CLIENTE" VARCHAR(200),
	"MONTO" DECIMAL(26,9),
	"MSG" CLOB,
	"ERROR" VARCHAR(2000),
	"PROCESANDO" INT DEFAULT 0,
	"NUM_INTENTOS" INT DEFAULT 0,
	"FECHA_ULTIMO_INTENTO" TIMESTAMP,
	 PRIMARY KEY ("ID")
);


SELECT * FROM JB_HISTORICO_DOCS_SINCRONIZADOS

CREATE COLUMN TABLE "JB_HISTORICO_DOCS_SINCRONIZADOS" (
	"ID" INTEGER CS_INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
	"TIPO_DOC" VARCHAR(200),
	"FECHA_SINCRONIZACION" TIMESTAMP,
	"FECHA_INGRESO_SAP" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	"VENDEDOR" VARCHAR(200),
	"CLIENTE" VARCHAR(200),
	"MONTO" DECIMAL(26,9),
	"MSG" CLOB,
	 PRIMARY KEY ("ID")
);
